MACARONI SALAD
Yields 3 quarts

1 cups	whole milk
3 cups	mayonnaise
1 tbsp	brown sugar
	Salt and pepper
1 pound	elbow macaroni
1/2 cup	cider vinegar
4	scallions , sliced thin
1	large carrot , peeled and grated
1	celery rib , chopped fine

1.	Make dressing
a.	Whisk ¾ cups milk, 1 ½ cup mayonnaise, sugar, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and
2 teaspoons pepper in bowl
2.	Cook pasta
a.	Bring 4 quarts water to boil in large pot
b.	Add 1 tablespoon salt and pasta and cook until very soft, about 15
minutes
c.	Drain pasta and return to pot
d.	Add vinegar and toss until absorbed
e.	Transfer to bowl
f.	Cool pasta 10 minutes
3.	Stir in dressing until pasta is well coated
a.	Cool completely
4.	Make salad
a.	Add scallions, carrot, celery, remaining milk, and remaining mayonnaise to
pot with pasta mixture and stir to combine
b.	Season with salt and pepper
c.	Transfer to a serving bowl and refrigerate, covered, for at least 1 hour or
up to 2 days.
